description.en:
Adds a player to, or removes them from, the match's forced-lose list. It is the mirror of CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN: the clash resolution checks both lists for the players taking part in a clash and overrides the result the ScBtlCalc_* callback computed.
Adding a player to this list also removes them from the forced-win list. Removing them (false) takes them out of both lists.

The player can be given in three ways, chosen by the number of arguments:
- 2 arguments (enable, charaId): by parameter ID.
- 3 arguments (enable, memberIndex, teamSlot): member number memberIndex of that team's match roster. It is turned into that member's parameter ID at the time of the call.
- 4 arguments (enable, slotOffset, teamSlot, any): whoever stands at position slotOffset among that team's players on the pitch, checked at each clash. The fourth argument is not read.
An entry is removed only by a call that names it the same way.
The list holds up to 32 entries. CMND_BTL_RESET_FORCE_LOSE empties it.
true to add the player to the forced-lose list, false to remove them.

2-argument form: parameter ID (e.g. "para_cp0008").
3-argument form: member number in the team's match roster.
4-argument form: position offset among the team's players on the pitch.
3- and 4-argument forms: team of the player, 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Only there to select the 4-argument form; never read. The scripts pass true.
Always null (also when fewer than 2 arguments are given).

examples.case: Switching position 0 of the opponent from forced win to forced lose (real usage, from btl0014.nut)
Clearing roster members 1 to 10 of the player's team (real usage, from btl0003.nut)
